text: # Ahmet Yagmur - Curriculum Vitae ## Overview Software Engineer & AI Researcher specializing in Agentic AI systems, local LLM optimization, and Python backend development. ## Work Experience - **Software Engineer Intern - AI Systems** (2025 - Present) - Designed and deployed high-throughput RAG systems and local model routing gateways. - **Python Developer** (2023 - 2025) - Built scalable REST APIs, Redis caching, and microservices architecture. ## Education - **Master of Science in Computer Science**, Frankfurt University (2024 - 2026)

# Personal AI Agent — System Specifications ## Architecture Overview The Personal AI Agent is a local-first executive assistant designed for low resource footprint (16GB RAM CPU). - **Core Brain:** Qwen 2.5 1.5B (Local via Ollama) - **Embeddings:** nomic-embed-text - **Triage Pipeline:** Two-stage hybrid engine (Deterministic Rules + Fact Extraction LLM) - **Knowledge Storage:** JSON-backed persistent vector store (`data/knowledge/vector_store.json`)

# Email Handling & Privacy Preferences ## Rules for Email Processing 1. Never auto-delete emails from bank or financial institutions. 2. Mark all marketing emails containing unsubscribe links as Irrelevant. 3. Automated job alerts from LinkedIn are to be classified as Normal priority.

# Computer Science Master's Module Guide 2026 ## Advanced Agentic AI (CS-801) - **Course Coordinator:** Prof. Davis - **Grading Scheme:** Project Assignment (60%), Final Exam (40%). - **Submission Policy:** All project assignments must be submitted to the university portal before noon on the designated deadline day. Late submissions incur a 10% penalty per 24 hours. - **Office Hours:** Wednesdays 14:00 - 16:00 in Room 402. ## Machine Learning & Caching (CS-705) - **Course Coordinator:** Dr. Smith - **Prerequisites:** Python, Linear Algebra, Data Structures.
